title: Stationfall: Core Loop
summary: Secure compartments, read station hazards, salvage, and retreat before systems fail.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Board, stabilize pressure or oxygen, gather one objective, watch panic, unlock access deliberately, and leave while reserves are still comfortable.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each compartment, check access, air, power, loot weight, and retreat path. Station runs collapse when one margin is ignored.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop at a sealed door, unstable system, or full pack. A mapped station can be revisited; a failed retreat cannot.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
